progress_queue=None, cancel_event=None):\n        """Analyze a BOM in a worker thread without touching Streamlit state."""\n        from src.bom_parser import (\n            aggregate_bom_rows,\n rows\n        }\n        if progress_queue is not None:\n            first_mpn = str(rows[0].get("mpn") or "") if rows else ""\n            progress_queue.put((0, total_parts, first_mpn))\n\n        try:\n            for future in as_completed(future_to_row):\n                if cancel_event is not None and cancel_event.is_set():\n                    for pending_future in future_to_row:\n                        pending_future.cancel()\n                    executor.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)\n                    return None\n\n                row = future_to_row[future]\n                try:\n                    results.append(future.result(timeout=30))\n                except Exception as e:\n                    results.append(\n                        {\n
